# Explicitly Unqualified Native Moco Feasibility

## Purpose and Authority

Issue #12225 implements the epic #11784 generic-model decision: unavailable
human passive-force limits do not require inventing limits before a conditional
numerical experiment. This opt-in permits the existing Moco solver and saved
excitation replay to run. It grants no physiological, anatomical, capture,
publication or full-swing qualification.

## Model and Input Identity

`NativeMocoRequest.allow_unqualified_passive_diagnostic` is an explicit boolean,
defaulting to false. It is valid only when `passive_policy` is unavailable.
Strings, integers and null are rejected. The true disposition contributes to
the request SHA-256; default false preserves the existing request identity.
The strict JSON entry point accepts the same optional field. Preparation saves
the disposition, and solve/export reject disagreement with the frozen request.

## Numerical Admission Equation

Let P mean a present, admitted, source-bound physical-body audit, B the complete
ordered preparation blocker tuple, D the explicit diagnostic disposition, and
O a present native passive-observation digest. Software readiness is

`P and (B is empty or (D and O and B == ("passive-policy-unavailable",)))`.

The diagnostic branch does not remove the blocker. It permits exactly that
single unavailable-policy disposition while keeping its native observation.
No numeric muscle-force threshold, epsilon inertia, new optimizer or source
law is introduced. Supplied passive limits cannot be overridden by this flag.

## State, Force and Observation Semantics

The existing fresh native source/state and passive observers still run. They
must evaluate finite native quantities and preserve their original blockers.
Complete named state, declared constraints/chart, capture registration, marker
bindings, control coverage and any explicit mixed-actuation profile remain
necessary. Missing observation evidence or any additional blocker prohibits
the solve. The body-property sidecar is independently re-audited before solve
and export; source, guess, original clock and registered reference remain bound.

## Independent Replay and Interpretation

The same solver, T01 saved control bundle, independent replay and marker score
are used. The preparation retains `passive-policy-unavailable`; preparation and
solve retain `not-qualified-for-muscle-matching`. Successful convergence or a
finite replay score is not passive admission. Report observed fiber lengths,
elastic/damping/tendon forces, assistance and all remaining scientific gates.
Never silently modify muscle parameters to make a diagnostic fit plausible.

## Validation and Reproduction

`tests/opensim/test_native_moco_diagnostic.py` starts RED with the missing opt-in.
Actual OpenSim 4.6 tests cover both Millard and Thelen laws: default refusal,
opted-in solve/export/fresh replay/score, retained blocker and qualification,
additional blocker/absent observer/invalid physical audit refusal, request and
preparation drift, invalid booleans, JSON round-trip and supplied-policy refusal.

Run serially with the installed SDK interpreter, matching native `CASADIPATH`:

```text
python -m pytest tests/opensim/test_native_moco_diagnostic.py -q -o addopts=''
```

The 10 ms software fixture is not capture evidence. The conditional 557-muscle
model's initial 56-by-56 mass matrix was positive definite in a separate local
diagnostic; neither that observation nor this opt-in qualifies the failed
original model or the generic shoulder registration. Full driver/iron horizons,
muscular control, own support/contact/grip, complete-state independent replay
and all 17 model/variant rows across six ecosystems remain required.
